fullTextZH: 今天我们要学习10个最常说的量词
fullTextEN: Today we are going to learn 10 of the most commonly used measure words.

fullTextZH: 量词就是用来说事物数量的词
fullTextEN: Measure words are words used to indicate the quantity of things.

fullTextZH: 比如在英语里我们说one apple
fullTextEN: For example, in English we say one apple.
The one we use most often is 'ge'.
For example, I have an apple.
This bread bag is very pretty.

fullTextZH: 第二个之我们经常用只来说动物
fullTextEN: The second is 'zhi', which we often use to talk about animals.
For example, it has a cat.
There are 5 elephants in the zoo.
For example, I bought a book
There are many books in the library
For example, he has a photo

fullTextZH: 比如我买了一件新衣服
fullTextEN: For example, I bought a new piece of clothing

fullTextZH: 昨天有一件有趣的事情
fullTextEN: Yesterday there was an interesting thing
This piece of clothing is very beautiful

fullTextZH: 第六个杯我想喝一杯水
fullTextEN: The sixth cup I want to drink a glass of water
He drinks two cups of coffee every day
Oh, this cup of tea is very hot
I ate a bowl of rice
I bought a new pair of shoes
This pair of socks is very pretty
There are many cars in the parking lot
He bought a pair of pants

fullTextZH: 一条鱼我看到了一条蛇
fullTextEN: I saw a snake and a fish.

fullTextZH: 我们看看小明家有什么
fullTextEN: Let's see what Xiaoming's house has.
There is a book in the backpack.
There is a photo on the table.
There is a glass of water on the table.
There is a bowl of rice on the table.
There is a bed in the room.
There is a puppy on the bed.
There is a piece of clothing on the ground.
A pair of shoes and a pair of pants.
Have you learned the measure words now?
Feel free to leave a comment and tell me.
